floorPlans.introduction: Compare the eleven published four bedroom villa sheets, including the available mirrored styles. Each complete sheet includes three floors, its area table and the developer key plan.
floorPlans.note: Published totals include suite, terrace/balcony and carport; they are not plot areas. Some rounded components add to 0.01 sq ft above the printed total; the published total is retained. Plans label a linen room, so a separate maid bedroom is not assumed. Confirm final specifications and landscape inclusions.
